title: Add a failing test then implement until pytest is green
narrative: Fangore asks the delegate to fix from a red test: pin `double()` in pytest first, then implement until the suite is green under verify_repair — the classic expensive coding handoff.
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `guided_coding` with `environment.local_work: project_coding`, `environment.workspace: suite`, soft point `external_guidance` (choices minimal/thorough), and budget soft point `max_iterations`. List stages pass `instruction_mode: list` into `ProjectCodingLocalWork` / `build_instruction_plan`. Host `verify_runs` include `pytest: true` and `text_contains` / `text_forbids` with repair. Live mode binds `completer_as_tool_loop_complete`; static `coding_writes` are provisional until the live suite passes. MCP `MECHA_MCP_HOST=project_coding` drives the same `DurableGraphGenerator` graph (no separate suite).
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `red_green.yaml` inside sequential suite `delegate_pkg` (ordered). Live eligibility: `environment.local_work: project_coding`. Do not treat static/cassette green as proof until live Completer on the suite host has passed.
